title.narrative: Integrated Nutrition and WASH response to conflicted affected regions in northern Ethiopia and drought-affected regions of Oromia and Somali regions

description.narrative: This UNICEF project focuses on Nutrition and WASH response to conflicted affected regions in northern Ethiopia and drought-affected regions of Oromia and Somali regions.UNICEF and its partners provide treatment for SAM, including outpatient therapeutic programme (OTP) management of SAM cases without medical complications and inpatient management of SAM cases with medical complications in Stabilization Centres (SCs). Under WASH, UNICEF prioritizes the provision of emergency water supply in locations without water access and WASH non-food items (NFIs), including household water treatment chemicals, water storage containers, and hygiene-keeping items. The project provides humanitarian assistance to 163,700 people, including 40,793 women, 35,955 men, 86,952 children, and including 24,555 persons with disabilities.
